With escapeParameter/escapeParameterHtml enabled, translate() calls escapeParams() which runs escapeHtml only on list/named interpolation values before resolveMessageFormat, then returns the completed string. A trusted translation that already contains HTML attribute context (e.g. onerror="{payload}" or javascript: URLs) can therefore still produce executable HTML when the result is rendered (v-html). The original escapeHtml in 69489802dea27889ce323a8dd528a8d9da4aa0db / identical-tree squash 154076727da3aa1c3b5f70abd46c5d5a9c3a35ef only rewrites & < > " '. Direct fixes add sanitizeTranslatedHtml on the completed result and neutralize event-handler attributes and javascript: URLs. CWE-79 DOM XSS is real; the CNA text that names 11.1.0 as the v11 fix is imprecise versus GHSA/tags (actual first patched v11 tag is v11.1.10).
